source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Copy the start date and the survey start times and put them on Google Calendar, adding whatever time zone information you will need: The records on GHC have the time in PT time, as is normal for internal documents, but the building check is done in the local time so the time on the survey will match whatever timezone you are in
3. Schedule a reminder search (|GCAL search:) if you do not have a standing reminder.
4. Schedule a reminder for each individual follow-up item (|GCAL reminder:)
5. Look up the inspection record if you need any information (i.e. to remember what address you are going to)
6. Click the link in the reminder to get to the [survey](#)
7. On the survey, mention that it is follow-up.
8. Add the same start date and start time that you copied above.
9. Complete the survey
10. Go
